cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Three more departments to cover! My influence is spreading.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no extra budget. You'll have to borrow their meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Excellent. I'll have a presence in every department.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll find a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A mobile headquarters! Put the department names on it; they'll see how far my jurisdiction extends.

mechanism: A corrects descriptions of budget and space losses into professional signs of expanding jurisdiction, celebrating each new burden as influence.
confusable: D65 claims deliberate concessions from strength; D68 celebrates imposed burdens specifically as evidence of growing influence rather than chosen retreat.
comparison: Hotel alternative treats investigation and laundry assignment as institutional reach; departments alternative treats borrowed rooms and trolley as mobile jurisdiction.
seedUse: Three departments, no budget, borrowed rooms, lost desk and file trolley derive from D68-a; S03 adds precise jurisdiction labels.
